complex_text: Any person aggrieved by a decision of the Public Information Officer may prefer an appeal under Section 19(1) of the RTI Act within thirty days from the expiry of the prescribed period.
simple_text: If you are unhappy with the officer's reply or received no response, you can file a First Appeal within 30 days under Section 19(1).

complex_text: Under Section 8(1)(a), information disclosure prejudicially affecting the sovereignty and integrity of India, the security, or strategic interests of the State is exempted from disclosure.
simple_text: Information cannot be shared if releasing it could harm national security, strategic interests, or the sovereignty of India.
